language.title: Choose your interface language
language.subtitle: You can change it later in your profile.

level.title: How good is your Spanish?
level.subtitle: Pick the level that feels closest. It only tunes your recommendations.

mic.title: You'll answer with your voice
mic.body: At key moments the video pauses and Lucía waits for your reply. We use the microphone only while you answer. Audio is not stored.
mic.denied: Microphone access was blocked. You can still answer by tapping phrases.
mic.unsupported: This browser can't access the microphone here. Open the app over HTTPS.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.subtitle: Short video stories. Answer out loud when the video pauses.

player.title: Lesson
player.micDenied: Microphone is blocked. Tap a phrase to answer instead.
player.micError: Couldn't record. Try again or tap a phrase.

result.title: Lesson result
result.noResult: You haven't finished this lesson yet.

perfect.title: Perfect!
perfect.body: You got exactly what you came for. Nice work!

partial.title: Almost there
partial.body: You left the shop, but not with what you wanted. Fix the moment that went sideways and try again.

missed.title: Not this time
missed.body: The conversation ended before you got what you needed. Replay it: the phrases are below.

result.stumblesNone: No slips — every answer was understood.

profile.title: Profile
profile.goalPlaceholder: Where are you going and why?

mic.title: Microphone
mic.hint: Records 3 seconds and plays them back. Nothing is uploaded.
mic.denied: Microphone access was blocked. Allow it in the browser site settings.
mic.unsupported: Microphone isn't available in this browser or over plain HTTP.

reset.title: Reset progress?
reset.body: All completed lessons will be cleared. Your settings stay.
